Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling southbound in the left lane when the vehicle drifted across the center line and struck the front
of an oncoming vehicle operated by Driver 2. The impact was low speed but direct, and both vehicles came to rest in
the roadway. Driver 1 remained in the driver's seat until responding units arrived and reported pain in the left knee. A
passenger in the front seat of Driver 1's vehicle was also present and was checked at the scene. Driver 2 stated that
the collision occurred just as described by Driver 1, and two independent witnesses on the shoulder gave consistent
accounts. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the front bumper, hood, and grille of Driver 1's vehicle
and matching damage to the front end of Driver 2's vehicle, consistent with a head-on contact at the reported point of
impact. Officers found no evidence of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the
registration and policy documents presented at the scene. Driver 1 was transported by ambulance for evaluation of
the knee injury, which appeared consistent with the forces involved in this collision.
